newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait's crown prince to leave hospital Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait's crown prince to leave hospital Thursday.

text.p: Kuwait's Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah will leave hospital on Thursday, an official said.
"God willing His Highness would leave the hospital today (Thursday). His condition is good," an official who declined to be identified said.

Sheikh Saad, born in 1930, fainted on Tuesday evening and suffered "slight bruises," a senior member of the al-Sabah ruling family told Reuters. Newspapers said on Wednesday he had suffered internal bleeding.
The emiri court initially issued a statement saying Sheikh Saad was taken to hospital after a "sudden indisposition". It said his condition was "extremely reassuring".
